title: Prospective registry for recording surgical treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia
summary:
The registry routinely collects surgical and patient data from the surgical treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia. 
Based on the data collected, potential correlations between surgical outcomes and various influencing factors will be investigated. These factors include patient-specific factors (e.g., prostate size or medication) and surgical factors (e.g., surgical instruments used). The data from the registry will be evaluated by research assistants in studies based on specific questions.

interventions.name:
